title: Fisher of Men Inshore Charters
specs: Boat with enclosed cabin and restroom
Captain Randy Elliott has over 50 years fishing experience
blurb: Guests fish in calm inland waters or nearshore ocean areas targeting species like Redfish, Speckled Trout, Flounder, Seabass, Shark, Spanish Mackerel, Barracuda, Bonito, and King Mackerel. Trips include all bait, tackle, fishing licenses, and a first mate. The boat has an enclosed cabin with restroom and USCG safety equipment.
extraNote: Free cancellation with 1 day notice · Captain decides on trip delay, reschedule, or cancellation due to weather · Full refund or credit offered if trip cancelled due to weather and rescheduling not possible · Cricket Cove Marina, 4495 Baker Street, Little River, SC 29566 · Seasonal trips Monday through Saturday, some trips Sep 1 - May 31
